query:entirely_above_threshold_count.answer_hint: set "answer" to the requested integer count
query:entirely_above_threshold_count.annotation_hint: set "annotation" to an array of [x0,y0,x1,y1] boxes around each counted error-bar mark for the named series

query:entirely_below_threshold_count.answer_hint: set "answer" to the requested integer count
query:entirely_below_threshold_count.annotation_hint: set "annotation" to an array of [x0,y0,x1,y1] boxes around each counted error-bar mark for the named series

query:contains_threshold_count.answer_hint: set "answer" to the requested integer count
query:contains_threshold_count.annotation_hint: set "annotation" to an array of [x0,y0,x1,y1] boxes around each counted error-bar mark for the named series

query:highest_upper_bound_x_label.answer_hint: set "answer" to the exact visible x-axis label as a string
query:highest_upper_bound_x_label.annotation_hint: set "annotation" to an object mapping "selected_bound_endpoint" to the [x,y] pixel point on the selected error-bar endpoint

query:lowest_lower_bound_x_label.answer_hint: set "answer" to the exact visible x-axis label as a string
query:lowest_lower_bound_x_label.annotation_hint: set "annotation" to an object mapping "selected_bound_endpoint" to the [x,y] pixel point on the selected error-bar endpoint

query:overlap_target_errorbar_at_x_count.answer_hint: set "answer" to the requested integer count
query:overlap_target_errorbar_at_x_count.annotation_hint: set "annotation" to an object mapping "target_errorbar" to the [x0,y0,x1,y1] box around the target error bar and each counted series label to its overlapping error-bar box
